svg.desc: AI-generated ornament (recraft/recraft-v4.1-vector via OpenRouter, 2026-11-12). Prompt: Minimal luxury line-art vector for a fine jewellery maison. A quarter arc of a fine mandala: three concentric partial rings with small petal ticks, as a corner ornament. Drawn as one continuous very thin elegant line in muted antique gold (#C5A059) on a pure transparent background. Single line weight, no fill, no shading, lots of empty space, refined, calm. No text.
